loreJson.text: A broad iron face is flat and heavy enough for repairing equipment or setting a name.
A slender wooden frame rests on a stone base, ready to hold a complete set of armour.
Bands hold the staves together, with an end opening useful in a narrow storeroom.
A clear casing surrounds a bright core that needs a mineral foundation to reach far.
The brass body rings clearly enough to call villagers indoors.
Iron plates enclose the mouth, smelting ore quickly but serving poorly as a kitchen.
Thick books fill the wooden bays, furnishing a wall and lending knowledge to an enchanting table.
Logs smoulder in a low rack that cooks food without fresh fuel.
Map lines mark a flat top suited to copying and scaling charts.
Deep iron sides hold water, snow or lava without a fuss.
Dark iron links join in sequence, useful for hanging lamps and suspended work.
Boards enclose a plain box whose lid needs clear space above it.
A piece has broken from the corner; work can continue, though not indefinitely.
Six separate book slots give frequently used volumes their own place.
Gaps ring the wooden bin where plant scraps build into a little bone meal.
Prismarine pieces surround a firm core that protects divers inside a submerged frame.
Knife marks divide the top into squares, with room to assemble a complete piece of work.
Deep cracks cross the iron face, which may not survive another job.
Four patterned faces enclose a broad clay body, decorative and useful for storing one kind of item.
A turning book rests on the dark base; room for nearby shelves matters.
A narrow white light has neat ends and fits even a cramped passage.
Purple light escapes the dark casing, opening onto the owner's own storage each time.
Feather markings line the edge of a workbench a village fletcher can claim.
A thick rim surrounds the little clay pot, filled well by a single small flower.
Black ash lines the stone firebox, adequate for smelting ore or cooking a meal.
A lit leather backing keeps its displayed item visible in a dark corner.
Golden crystals bind together into ceiling lights that save room for torches.
A coarse wheel sits in its frame, ready to strip enchantments or repair two worn tools together.
A leather backing stretches across the thin wooden frame, enough for a storage sample.
Firelight fills the hollow orange rind, keeping both a lamp and a carved face.
A narrow slot in the wooden case takes a disc and plays its full recording.
Short rungs join two rails, saving the space a staircase would occupy.
An iron frame guards a warm light that hangs clear of a doorway.
A sloped wooden rest holds a book open at a comfortable reading height.
Metal bands bind the grey stone, giving a touched compass a fixed point to follow.
Even warp threads stretch across the wooden frame, making banner patterns easier to weave.
Pale yellow light passes through a soft-looking face, comfortable in a row of lamps.
Thin canvas stretches over a wooden frame, with a wider scene for a broader wall.
A pale pink sheen spreads across the face and sits gently in a white wall.
A luminous recess sits in the dark frame, ready for glowstone and a foothold in the Nether.
Bamboo poles support a thin platform that extends upward without a solid tower beneath it.
Milky crystal gives an even light that remains clear beside a pool.
Bright points fill the orange fungus and shine through surrounding leaves.
Metal edges bind the dark top, with room to upgrade equipment and apply a trim.
A wooden frame surrounds the smoking chamber, quick for food but unable to smelt ore.
Blue flames move along the logs, hot nearby but modest in reach.
Cold blue fire sits inside an iron casing, a subdued light beneath an eave.
A small blue flame tops the stick, modest in brightness and enough to turn piglins away.
A round blade rises from the stone bed, trimming steps and edges with less waste.
Coal coats one end of a stick, lighting a small patch once set down.
The pale green face gives even light along the edge of a garden path.
